units.source_text: 认真说来，那时候他不过是对自己一伙人的复仇事件，竟然在想的没想过的地方产生了那么深远的影响，感到吃惊罢了。

en.t: Strictly speaking, at that moment he was merely surprised that his own group's revenge had produced such far-reaching effects in places he had never expected.

units.source_text: 假如在平常，他会和藤左卫门和忠左卫门一样，笑笑算了。

en.t: Under ordinary circumstances, he would have laughed it off just as Tozaemon and Chuzaemon did.

units.source_text: 但是这个事实依然给他志得意满的心里洒下了不开心的种子。

en.t: Yet this fact still scattered a seed of displeasure into his self-satisfied heart.

units.source_text: 这很可能是因为他的心满意足多少有点自说自话的成分，暗地里却与事实逻辑背道而驰吧。

en.t: That was probably because his satisfaction contained a certain amount of self-deception and, underneath, ran against the logic of the facts.

units.source_text: 当然了，这个时候他没想过用逻辑来分析问题。

en.t: Of course, at that time he had no thought of analyzing the matter logically.

units.source_text: 他不过是觉得志得意满的深处有股寒风冷气，这让他有种难以严明的苦恼。

en.t: He merely felt a cold wind stirring in the depths of his triumph, and it gave him a kind of anguish that was hard to define.
